unit_attributes.statement: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary, on or about the individual's person or accessible property: (1) when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; (2) when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under 49 CFR 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section; on or about the individual's person or accessible property; and when performance has begun of inspection before entering a sterile area or boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter, when entering or in a sterile area, or when attempting to board or onboard an aircraft screened under 49 CFR 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Either (1) when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; (2) when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under 49 CFR 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.

unit_attributes.statement: Paragraph (a) of this section does not apply as to carriage of firearms and other weapons if the individual is: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with 49 CFR 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562; or (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.scope_text: As to carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property, when the individual meets one of the specified authorization categories.
unit_attributes.choice_text: The individual is one of the following: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) an individual authorized to carry a weapon under 49 CFR 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562; or (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.

unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23 any loaded firearm(s).
unit_attributes.scope_text: For a passenger, in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23.

unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23 any unloaded firearm(s) unless all of the following conditions are met: (i) the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded; (ii) the firearm is unloaded; (iii) the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; and (iv) the container in which it is carried is locked, and only the passenger retains the key or combination.
unit_attributes.scope_text: For a passenger transporting or offering for transport any unloaded firearm(s) in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23, unless all specified conditions (i) through (iv) are met.
unit_attributes.choice_text: All four conditions must be satisfied: declaration to the aircraft operator orally or in writing before checking baggage that the bag contains an unloaded firearm; the firearm is unloaded; the firearm is in a hard-sided container; and the container is locked with only the passenger retaining the key or combination.

unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23 any unauthorized explosive or incendiary.
unit_attributes.scope_text: For a passenger, in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23.

unit_attributes.statement: Section 1540.111 does not prohibit the carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm, while Title 49 CFR part 175 provides additional requirements governing carriage of ammunition on aircraft.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.
